gloss.intro: The words developers (and the 🤖 teams) use, in plain English.
gloss.switch.help: Dotted words get a plain explanation when you hover them.
gloss.backlog.text: 💡 Ideas and work not planned in yet. Nothing there gets worked on until it moves to To do.
gloss.sprint.text: 🏃 A short stretch of work (often a week or two) with an agreed set of cards to finish.
gloss.standup.text: 📣 A quick check-in: what each team member did, what they do next, and what is stopping them.
gloss.bug.text: 🐞 Something that doesn’t work the way it should.
gloss.test.text: 🧪 Trying a finished piece of work to check it does what was asked, before you accept it.
gloss.commit.text: 📸 A saved snapshot of the code, with a short note of what changed. You can always go back to one.
gloss.push.text: ⬆️ Sending saved snapshots (commits) from this 💻 up to GitHub, so they are backed up and shared.
gloss.branch.text: 🌿 A separate line of work in the code, so changes can be made without touching the main version.
gloss.merge.text: 🔀 Joining a branch’s changes back into the main version.
gloss.repo.text: 📁 The project’s folder of code and its full history of commits, usually also kept on GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: 🧹 Tidying the code without changing what it does: smaller files, clearer names, less repetition.
gloss.deploy.text: 🚀 Putting a new version live, for example onto a server where people use it.
gloss.kanban.text: 📋 A board with columns (To do, In progress, Done) where cards move left to right as work happens.
gloss.wip.text: 🚦 Work in progress: the most cards a column should hold, so the team finishes things before starting more.
gloss.pr.text: 🔀 Asking for a branch’s changes to be checked and merged into the main version.
gloss.hook.text: 🪝 A small command that runs by itself at a set moment, e.g. when an AI session starts, so the team hears your comments.
gloss.token.text: 🪙 The unit AI usage is counted in: roughly a few letters of text read or written. Fewer tokens, more of your plan left.
gloss.agent.text: 🤖 An AI that works on its own on a task: reads the code, makes changes, runs checks, and reports back.
tour.btn.title: 🎓 A short guided tour of the board
tour.intro: A few stops around the board. How much do you want?
tour.lvl.new.help: Every stop, and why it works this way. Developer words get explained too.
tour.lvl.refresh.help: The main stops, in a line each.
tour.welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: A board where 🤖 teams do the work and you decide, test and accept. Here is how to find your way around.
tour.welcome.short: 🏃 A quick lap of the board.
tour.welcome.why: 💡 The idea: the teams do the busywork, and you only see what needs a human.
tour.rail.title: 📁 Your projects
tour.rail.text: 🏠 Home, 📥 your inbox, 💬 chats with the leads, then one icon per project. A 🟣 diamond means something there is waiting on you. Drag icons to put them in your order.
tour.rail.short: Projects on the left; 🟣 diamonds mean something waits on you.
tour.rail.why: 👀 One glance tells you where you are needed, without opening anything.
tour.inbox.title: 📥 Your inbox
tour.inbox.text: Everything waiting on you, across every project: ❓, to-dos only you can do, and 🧪. Click a chip to see just that kind.
tour.inbox.short: All that waits on you, everywhere. Click a chip for one kind.
tour.inbox.why: You shouldn’t have to visit every project to know what needs you.
tour.foryou.title: 🙋 For you
tour.foryou.text: On a board, this column holds what waits on you in that project. Open a 🧪, follow its steps, then ✅ Accept or 🔁 Send back with a reason.
tour.foryou.short: This project’s pile for you: test, then ✅ or 🔁.
tour.foryou.why: Teams never mark their own work done: you accept it. That keeps quality in your hands.
tour.cards.title: 👥 The teams’ columns
tour.cards.text: The rest of the board is the teams’ work: Backlog, To do, In progress and so on. 💬 on any card and the team wakes up to deal with it.
tour.cards.short: The teams’ work. 💬 on a card to wake them.
tour.cards.why: Your comments are instructions. The board starts the team when you write.
tour.chat.title: 💬 Chat with the leads
tour.chat.text: Message a project’s lead with an idea or a question. They turn ideas into cards and a short plan, with Go buttons for you.
tour.chat.short: Message a lead; they plan it and you click 👍 Go.
tour.chat.why: Nothing gets built until you say go: you stay in charge of what happens.
tour.setup.title: ⚙️ Setup
tour.setup.text: Your name, language, theme and where the AI lives on this 💻. There is also a switch to explain developer words, and the 📖 glossary.
tour.setup.short: Your settings, language and the 📖 dev-word glossary.
tour.done.title: 🎉 That’s it!
tour.done.text: Take the tour again any time from the home page. Raise a card or message a lead to get started.
tour.done.short: 👋 Off you go. The tour is on the home page any time.
